description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality and robustness of 'git log' and associated commands in handling corrupted or malformed commit data. It defines test cases to verify behavior with broken commit headers, invalid author emails, date parsing issues, and whitespace handling, among others.

methods.name: munge_author_date
methods.description: A helper function that modifies a commit's author date to a specified value by rewriting the commit object.
